astronotus-ocellatus.name: Oscar
notes: Item 2: 'Minimum tank size: 65 gallons (about 250 litres)' – 65 US gal ≈ 246 L, so this is fine; but 'Tank level: Top, mid-dweller' is rendered 'Bahagian atas dan tengah', which is acceptable. No fix needed here.

Item 14: the English contains stray Vietnamese '(cá Jack Dempsey)', '(cá Convict)', '(cá đô la bạc)'. The Malay drops them but adds 'ikan dolar perak'. Use the trade name 'Silver Dollar' alone or add the Malay gloss consistently.
Item 14: 'tumbuhan akuatik hidup yang berakar' is fine, but 'kebanyakannya cepat membesar' changes 'many' into 'most of them'. Use 'ramai'/'banyak yang'.
Item 17: 'akuarium awam serta kedai ikan hiasan sering ditawarkan lebih banyak ikan' is garbled. Say 'akuarium awam dan kedai kerap ditawarkan ikan lebih banyak daripada yang mampu ditampung'.

Item 17: 'induk' for parents and 'substrate-spawner' translated as 'bertelur di atas permukaan' is OK. But 'mempunyai nilai komersial yang rendah' is fine; 'dijaga dan diberi makan dengan betul' adds 'dijaga'. Use 'dikondisikan' (conditioned) instead.
Item 11: 'ikan bilis/anak ikan' for whitebait is imprecise. Use 'ikan bilis' only or 'whitebait'. 'makanan hidup atau sejuk beku' is OK.
Item 12: 'cacing darah' is fine, but 'karnivor tulen' for 'serious carnivores' is slightly changed. Use 'karnivor tegar'.
Item 7: 'heaterstat' is rendered 'pemanas (termostat pemanas)', which is confusing. Use 'pemanas bertermostat' or 'heater'.
Item 2: 'Care: Advanced' rendered 'Lanjutan (sukar)' adds 'sukar' and is unnatural. Use 'Mahir/Lanjutan'.
Item 6: the Malay omits the volume note '(~143 US gal)', which is fine as an imperial figure. No fix needed.

betta-splendens.name: Ikan laga
notes: Item 1: 'hybrid of sorts' rendered as 'boleh dikatakan sejenis hibrid' is awkward; also 'Tiada' for N/A is fine but 'Copper Alien Hybrid ... daripada kompleks' is clumsy.
Item 5: 'patut tidak digalakkan' is unnatural; use 'patut dihalang' or 'tidak wajar digalakkan'.
Item 9: 'Saiz tangki minimum: kira-kira 8 liter' fine, but 'ikan laga' is used for 'bettas' while 'balang' for 'bowl' is OK; 'mungkin hujah terbesar menentang' is stiff.
Item 11: 'Betta fish are low-maintenance' translated as 'mudah dijaga' - fine, but 'tukar air' used as noun is clumsy; use 'penukaran air'.
Item 12: 'daun kering' for 'dried leaf litter' loses 'leaf litter' sense; 'pelompat yang handal' is awkward for 'excellent jumper' (use 'pelompat yang hebat').
Item 14: 'air panas' for warm water suggests hot water; use 'air suam/hangat'. Same in items 2, 7, 16 ('air panas' for warm water). 'dilaburkan' in item 16 is odd for buying a heater.
Item 16: the English 'Consider ... floating or digital thermometer' fine, but 5 watts per gallon converted to 1.3 W/L is correct.
Item 18: 'Brine shrimp' rendered 'Artemia' and 'Glassworm' left in English; add Malay/hobby equivalents e.g. 'cacing kaca'. 'flake' left in English in several items; 'serpihan' is common alternative.
Item 27: 'Tukar air perlu dibuat dalam kuantiti kecil' awkward; 'sehingga telur betina habis' ok. 'milt' left untranslated - use 'sperma/air mani ikan'.

Item 29: 'turquoise' rendered 'biru firus' fine; 'oren' fine. Item 21/22: 'Species with body shapes ... ' in 22 omits 'similar' mismatch: English says 'body shapes or trailing finnage' (to avoid), MS adds 'serupa' – an added qualifier that is not in the source.

cyprinus-rubrofuscus.name: Ikan Koi
notes: Item 1: 'Temperature: 1 to 29 °C' is fine, but 'Saiz kolam minimum: kira-kira 950 liter' etc. OK. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 3: 'tangki itu sekurang-kurangnya kira-kira 1,900 liter' and 'sekurang-kurangnya kira-kira 950 liter' – 'sekurang-kurangnya kira-kira' is contradictory; use 'sekurang-kurangnya 950 liter'.
Item 2: 'dengan harga beribu-ribu ringgit seekor' changes 'thousands of dollars' to ringgit – currency changed, altering the fact; use 'beribu-ribu dolar'.

Item 2: 'ikan paling cantik' for 'most ornate'; also 'high-status markets' rendered 'pasaran berprestij tinggi' is acceptable but 'domestic-bred' rendered 'ternakan tempatan' implies local Malaysia; use 'ternakan dalam negara/bukan import'.
Item 7: 'ikan bandaraya (plecostomus)' – 'ikan bandaraya' is a common local name, fine, but 'Hi-fin shark ... lebih gemarkan pelet koi' is awkward; use 'lebih menggemari'.

Item 7: 'Koi ialah ikan yang suka hidup berkumpulan' fine; 'Naughty turtles' rendered 'nakal' ok. 'Breeding female koi ... menghasilkan telurnya' loses 'rear their egg masses' nuance; use 'membawa/membentuk jisim telur'.
Item 9: 'sebesar kepala pin' – use 'sebesar kepala jarum peniti'; 'benih' for fry should be 'anak ikan/fry'.
Item 6: 'Koi ... ialah omnivor yang mencari makan di dasar' fine; 'harga tidak menentukan' weakens 'no correlation' slightly; use 'harga tiada kaitan dengan kualiti makanan'.
Item 8: 'belum matang untuk membiak' repeats 'belum matang'; reword to 'belum matang secara pembiakan'.

danio-rerio.name: Zebra danio
notes: Item 27: 'lebih gelap dan lebih terang warnanya' reads as contradictory for 'darker and more intensely coloured'. Use 'lebih gelap dan warnanya lebih pekat/ketara'.
Item 13: '10-gallon (40-litre)' became '38 liter', but the later '40-litre tank' stays 40. Use one figure for the same tank size across the text.
Item 31: 'ikan keli' for 'catfishes' normally means Clarias to a Malaysian reader. Use 'ikan berkumis (catfish)' or just 'catfish'.

Item 33: the 'cross-reared' sentence is clumsy ('ikan yang dibesarkan bersama ikan bercorak lain (cross-reared) lebih menyukai corak ikan yang membesar bersamanya'). Rephrase so it says fish prefer the pattern of the fish they were raised with.
Item 24: 'larva' sits beside 'anak ikan' for the same life stage. Use one term consistently.

gymnocorymbus-ternetzi.name: Black Skirt Tetra
notes: #10: "semalap yang boleh" is non-standard and awkward. Use "semalap mungkin" or "sesuram yang boleh".

mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.name: Ram
notes: Item 3: "dataran yang dinaiki air secara bermusim" is slightly awkward; "dataran yang dilanda banjir bermusim" reads more naturally.
Item 11: "diatributkan kepada" is awkward; use "dikaitkan dengan" or "dikreditkan kepada".

neocaridina-davidi.name: Udang Neocaridina
notes: "bersalin kulit (molting)": "bersalin" usually means giving birth. Hobbyists more commonly write "menyalin kulit" or "tukar kulit". Minor.
"zukini": the usual Malaysian spelling is "zucchini" or "zuchini". Minor.

osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.name: Silver Arowana
notes: Item 8: "kekacang" for "fallen nuts" is imprecise. It means legumes. Use "kacang" or "buah keras", e.g. "kacang dan buah-buahan yang gugur".

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal tetra
notes: Item 5: "sejauh barat Colombia di sebelah barat" is redundant and garbled; use "hingga ke barat Colombia".
Item 20: English gives 26.5–29 °C (80–84 °F), but the Malay says "27–29 °C". The lower limit is wrong; 80 °F is about 26.5–27 °C, so write "26.5–29 °C".
Item 22: "Hypessobrycon simulans" and "P. inessi" repeat the source spellings. Latin names stay unchanged, so this is acceptable, but note the typo "Hypessobrycon".
Item 11: pH range "3.5–7.5" is kept as in the source, so no change is needed. The (GH) label was added to "Kekerasan air", which is fine.
Item 7: "hidup berkawan" is awkward for "live in shoals"; use "hidup berkawan/berkumpulan". The sentence also repeats "kawanan" from the previous one.
Item 21: "Ikan ini bertelur pada waktu petang" is fine. "wajib" for "essential" is slightly strong; "penting" is better.
Item 6: "menjulur ke atas air" for "overhanging" is acceptable. "hampir sebagai ikan tahunan" is awkward; use "hampir sepenuhnya ikan semusim".
Item 3: "jalur merahnya... memanjang di sepanjang badan" is slightly redundant, and "mid-body to tail" is rendered correctly.
Item 15: "flake" is left in English. Use "makanan serpihan (flake)".
Item 16: "ikan berkawan lain untuk memberi rasa selamat" is fine. "gasteropelecid" and similar family names are retained as in the source, which is acceptable.

paracheirodon-innesi.name: Neon Tetra
notes: Item 3: "Neon tetra pada umumnya semuanya hasil ternakan" is redundant and awkward. Use "Neon tetra yang dijual pada umumnya hasil ternakan".

poecilia-latipinna.name: Sailfin molly
notes: Item 2: "sejauh Kenya dan New Zealand" is awkward; use "hingga ke Kenya dan New Zealand".
Item 2: "kebanyakan besar ikan yang dijual" is awkward; use "sebahagian besar ikan yang dijual".
Item 7: "Ikan ternakan tangki" is clumsy; use "ikan hasil ternakan akuarium".
Item 7: "sayur-sayuran tidak mencukupi" loses the sense of 'greenstuff'; use "bahan hijau/sayuran".
Item 5: "jangkitan kulat" for 'fungus' is fine, but "sirip menguncup" (clamped fins) could be "sirip dikepit rapat".
Item 10: "bersungguh-sungguh mengejar pasangan" is slightly stiff; use "agresif mengejar betina".
Item 10: "Anak-anaknya agak besar" – 'relatively large' is OK, but "nauplii artemia" should read "nauplii udang brine (Artemia)".

poecilia-reticulata.name: Guppy
notes: #4: "saliran air panas" for "warm waterways" implies hot water or hot springs. Use "saliran air suam/hangat".
#15: "mudah dibawa berbincang" for "easygoing" is an odd idiom. Use "mudah dijaga" or "berwatak tenang".
#10: "tangki bertumbuhan dengan tumbuhan terapung" is awkward. Use "tangki bertumbuhan dengan tumbuhan terapung" or "tangki yang ditanam dengan tumbuhan akuatik termasuk tumbuhan terapung".
#20: "agresif" for "vigorous" shifts the meaning towards aggression. Use "bertenaga/gigih" for the males' pursuit.
#13: "flake" is left in English. Use "serpihan" or "makanan kepingan (flake)".

poecilia-sphenops.name: Molly
notes: Item 9: "supaya gangguan ini tidak tertumpu pada seekor betina sahaja" is an interpretive addition; "dissipate this" should be rendered more plainly, e.g. "supaya gangguan itu berkurang/terbahagi".
Item 3: "Ukuran dasar akuarium: 90 × 30 cm" is fine, but "Isi padu: ~81 liter" with "90 × 30 × 30 cm" left as a stray fragment is okay; no issue. (Ignore if no change is needed.)
Item 1 and 10: "tidak keras dan tidak beralkali" is correct, but "lebih sihat" for "do better" is acceptable; "bentuk warna" for "colour morphs" is stiff; use "varian warna" or "morf warna".
Item 9: "Kawasan yang ditanam tumbuhan dengan padat" is awkward; use "Kawasan yang ditanam padat dengan tumbuhan".
Item 4: "badan bergoyang-goyang di tempat (shimmying)" and "dijangkiti kulat" are acceptable, but "sirip menguncup" should be "sirip terkatup (clamped fins)".
Item 6: "flake sayuran" leaves English untranslated; use "serpihan (flake) sayuran".
Item 7: "hanya" placement is awkward: "patut dipelihara bersama ikan yang boleh tahan keadaan air yang sama sahaja"; use "hanya bersama ikan yang boleh menerima keadaan air yang sama".
Item 10: "Dalmatian" corrects the English typo "Dalmation", which is fine; "kitaran nitrogen (cycling)" is acceptable.

pterophyllum-scalare.name: Ikan Angel
notes: Item 2: "Adults reach 15 cm in body length and 20 cm or more in height" is rendered accurately, but "Sungai Amazon, Essequibo, Oyapock" adds "Sungai" only to Amazon. Write "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Essequibo, Sungai Oyapock" or drop it for all.
Item 7: "Tanam tumbuhan akuatik dengan lebat" is an awkward imperative for "Well planted". Use "Ditanam dengan padat dengan tumbuhan...". "digemari" is also stiff for "preferred"; use "lebih sesuai".
Item 10: "akan menerima pelet atau flake" leaves "flake" in English. Use "pelet atau serpihan (flake)". "menerima" is also literal; use "boleh diberi/menjamah".

Item 12: "pasti akan terbentuk sepasang" keeps the source's overconfident "sure to form". Soften it to "biasanya akan terbentuk" or keep it as is, but check that it reads naturally. "bertelur" for "spawning" is fine, but "papila genital ... kelihatan ketika bertelur" is OK.
Item 4/5: "lembangan utama Amazon" is fine, but "Timur Jauh" and "dalam hobi ini" are literal. Prefer "Asia Timur" and "dalam dunia hobi akuarium".
Item 3: "munisipaliti" is a stiff loanword. Use "perbandaran" or "daerah" Santa Isabel.
Item 13: "induk yang baik" for "good parents" is fine, but "ditukar kepada makanan anak ikan komersial" is awkward. Use "beralih kepada makanan anak ikan yang dijual di pasaran".

puntigrus-tetrazona.name: Tiger barb
notes: Item 17: "diisi dengan air matang" – in Malay "air matang" usually means boiled water. Use "air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)" or similar.
Item 17: "Kumpulan dewasa boleh dirangsang (conditioning)" is awkward. Use "dikondisikan" or "diberi makanan penyubur" instead.
Item 13: "ikan rainbow" is acceptable, but "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)" would be clearer for readers. "Bersaiz sama" is better than "sama saiz".
Item 12: "roughage" is rendered as "makanan berserat", but daphnia and brine shrimp are not fibre sources. Keep the sense of "roughage" and check the wording.

scleropages-formosus.name: Kelisa
notes: Item 9: 'Banjar Red' is a cross between 'super red' and 'yellowtail silver' — fine; but 'grey tail silver'/'yellow tail silver' region sentence: English 'between west and central Kalimantan provinces, and central and south Kalimantan provinces' is rendered correctly; no change needed here.
Item 5: 'Ia paling elok jika kandungan oksigen terlarut tinggi' is awkward; use 'Ia paling sesuai jika paras oksigen terlarut tinggi'.
Item 5: 'dalam persediaan yang kosong sepenuhnya' is awkward; better 'dalam akuarium tanpa hiasan/substrat sama sekali' (bare set-up).
Item 1/2/3: 'pupus setempat' for 'extirpated' is acceptable but 'pupus di sesetengah kawasan' is clearer; 'hutan yang ditenggelami air' better as 'hutan banjir'.
Item 7: 'dikondisikan dengan makanan berkualiti' adds detail ('berkualiti') not in source and is awkward; use 'diberi makanan khas/dikondisikan terlebih dahulu'.
Item 7: 'jantung lembu atau ayam' — 'ayam' is ambiguous as 'jantung ayam'; should be 'jantung lembu atau daging ayam'.

Item 7: 'larva chironomid (cacing darah)' fine, but 'pemendapan lemak' for fat deposits and 'kemerosotan organ' for organ degeneration are stiff; use 'pengumpulan lemak berlebihan' and 'degenerasi organ'.
Item 2: type locality quote left in English with a typo copied; acceptable as quotation, but the 'Lokaliti jenis' sentence leaves English text unglossed.
Item 6: temperature °F omitted per instructions; no issue.

symphysodon-aequifasciatus.name: Discus
notes: Item 8: 'terkenal sebagai yang paling cantik' weakens 'legendarily most beautiful'. Consider 'dikatakan legenda sebagai yang paling cantik' or 'terkenal secara legenda sebagai yang paling cantik'.

symphysodon-discus.name: Ikan Discus
notes: #10: 'sirip dubur' for 'anal fin' is fine, but 'Jalur biru ... meliputi sirip dorsal dan sirip dubur' is OK; however 'sirip dorsal, sirip ventral dan sirip dubur' mixes English loan and Malay terms — use consistent 'sirip belakang/dorsal', 'sirip perut/ventral', 'sirip dubur'.

#4: 'ditanam dengan baik' is awkward/ambiguous for 'well planted' (tank with many plants); use 'ditanam dengan banyak tumbuhan' or 'berpenanaman tumbuhan yang baik'. Also 'tangki' vs 'akuarium' inconsistent, and 'penapisan yang baik' repeats 'baik'.
#4: 'Discus tidak suka perubahan ... semakin perlahan perubahan itu berlaku' is acceptable; but 'liter' should be 'liter/L' consistently (fine).

#6: 'flake' left in English; use 'makanan serpai kering (flake)'. 'Jika diberi makan flake kering sahaja' adds 'sahaja' (only), which slightly shifts 'On a diet of dry flake' - acceptable but 'makan daripada badan induk' should be 'makan daripada sisi badan induk'.
#5: 'akuarium bertumbuhan yang sudah lama stabil' is awkward for 'well-established planted aquarium'; use 'akuarium berumput/tumbuhan yang sudah matang (established)'.
#7: 'pada musim bertelur' for 'at spawning time' — 'semasa waktu bertelur' is more natural; 'Sangat aman' should be 'Sangat jinak/tidak agresif'.
#8: 'Pada musim bertelur' similarly; 'papila genital ... tirus' fine. 'roe (eggs)' simplified to 'telur' - fine.
#1: 'kekal sebagai tambahan yang cantik' is literal; 'remain a beautiful addition' better as 'tetap menjadi pilihan yang menarik'.

trichogaster-lalius.name: Dwarf gourami
notes: Item 3: 'Minimum tank size: 15 gallons (~60 litres)' – 15 gallons is about 57 L, so ~60 L is fine, but item 10 is the real issue below.

Item 10: 'Tangki 60 cm x 30 cm x 30 cm (56 liter)' – 60x30x30 is 54 L and the original '56 litre' is kept; fine. However, item 11 '10-gallon (40-litre)' and '20–30 gallons (80–120 litres)' were kept as the source gave them; OK.
Item 14: 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is fine, but 'Jauhkan ikan ini daripada crayfish' leaves 'crayfish' untranslated; use 'udang karang (crayfish)'.
Item 21: 'Harlequin Trigonostigma heteromorpha' leaves the English common name without a Malay hobby form; use 'rasbora harlequin'.

Item 27: 'segenggam dua serat gambut' and 'plastik pembalut makanan' are acceptable; but 'Jantan langsung tidak dapat menerima kehadiran pasangannya lagi' is awkward; use 'Jantan tidak lagi bertoleransi terhadap pasangannya'.
Item 27: 'ia akan bertelur bila-bila masa ia mahu' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'ia akan bertelur dengan sendirinya'.
Item 20: 'Kutu air' for daphnia is non-standard hobby usage; Malaysian hobbyists say 'kutu air' for daphnia commonly, but also use 'daphnia'; consider adding the term.
Item 21: 'ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)' is fine, but 'Aras dalam tangki' in items 2 and 3 for 'Tank level/Dwellers' is stiff; consider 'Lapisan tangki'.
Item 19: 'Dalam kurungan' for 'in captivity' sounds like confinement; use 'Dalam akuarium' or 'Dalam penjagaan'.

trichopodus-leerii.name: Sepat mutiara
notes: Item 4: "dibiakkan dalam kurungan" is awkward for "in captivity". Use "dalam penangkaran" or "dibiakkan secara terkawal".
Item 9: "Susunan tangki bertumbuhan" reads unnaturally. Use "Tangki bertanaman" or "Susunan tangki yang ditanam tumbuhan".
Item 20: "tingkah laku mengurat" is too colloquial. Use "tingkah laku memikat" or "tingkah laku pemikatan".
Item 19: "pelukan yang biasa bagi anabantoid" is a little stiff. Use "pelukan pembiakan anabantoid yang lazim".

trichopodus-trichopterus.name: Sepat Ronggeng
notes: Item 9: "sirip dorsalnya menjadi tajam" is a little unnatural for "pointed dorsal fin". "runcing" is the more usual word.
Item 10: "menayangkan diri" for "display" is awkward. "mempamerkan diri" or "berlagak/menunjuk-nunjuk" is more natural courtship wording.
Items 1, 8: "sangat garang" for "spiteful" is acceptable but loses the sense of malice. "berdendam/jahat" or "nakal dan agresif" is closer.
Item 10: "flake yang dihancurkan menjadi serbuk" is wordy. "serpihan (flake) yang dihancurkan" would read better.

trigonostigma-heteromorpha.name: Harlequin rasbora
notes: Item 1: EN says 'Harlequin barb' but MS renders 'Harlequin rasbora' – the name was changed; keep faithful to the source or flag the discrepancy.

Item 8: '10 gallons (about 38 litres)' is correct, but 'Sehingga 10 ekor ... dalam akuarium 75 liter' is fine; the 'Saiz tangki minimum' line is OK. Note the 38 L minimum conflicts with item 9 (54 L), which comes from the source and not the translation.
Item 21: 'harlequin barb' was rendered as just 'harlequin'; this is acceptable but inconsistent with the source name.
Item 24: omitted the wholesale paragraph (codes 452523/452563 for Aquarium Glaser) and the byline; the byline and shop-talk omission is allowed, so no fix is needed there.

Item 22: 'Harlequin rasbora ... melekatkan telurnya' – 'egg layers' is rendered correctly, but 'Rasbora lain menabur telur secara rawak' adds 'secara rawak', which is not in the source sentence (minor).
Item 3: 'ikan ternakan kurang warnanya berbanding ikan liar' loses 'much of the colour' ('kehilangan banyak warna'); 'Harlequin' alone should be 'Harlequin rasbora'.
Item 22: 'jentik-jentik' for mosquito larvae is fine, but 'Harlequin lebih sukar dibiakkan' keeps 'Harlequins are among the more difficult', so this is OK.
Item 18: 'ikan keli' for 'catfishes' is misleading in Malaysia (keli means Clarias); use 'ikan duri/catfish' or 'ikan keli kecil (catfish)'.
Item 23: 'kekerasan 1–5 °H' is awkward; use dGH. 'mengurat' for male courtship is colloquial; use 'mengurat' or 'pamer pasangan' more neutrally.
Item 6: 'Rasbora ialah famili ikan air tawar sejati' – rasboras are not a family in the source's sense, but it follows the source, so no fix is needed.

xiphophorus-hellerii.name: Swordtail
notes: Item 10: "dari aras laut hingga kira-kira 1500 m dari aras laut" is repetitive. Use "dari aras laut hingga kira-kira 1500 m".
Item 23: "asid lemak perlu" and "asid amino perlu" are non-standard. Use "asid lemak/amino penting (esensial)".
Item 3: "Perangai: aman" and "Aras dalam tangki" are acceptable but a little stiff. "Sifat/Tingkah laku" and "Aras renang" are more natural.

xiphophorus-maculatus.name: Platy
notes: #25: "copulation usually takes place" is rendered "persenyawaan biasanya berlaku" (fertilization). Use "persetubuhan" or "kawin/mengawan". Fertilization is a separate step, covered under "Persenyawaan".
#25: "Mengurat" for courtship is colloquial and sounds odd in a handbook. Use "pertunangan/pemikatan" or "tingkah laku pemikat".
#18: "flake" is left in English. Use "makanan serpihan" or "flake (makanan serpihan)". The same applies in #20 for "Medaka ricefish", which should be "ikan medaka".
#27: "Famili: Poeciliidae; order: Cyprinodontiformes" mixes English and Malay. Use "Order" consistently, or "Famili ... ; Order ..." in the same style.
#20: "pameran sisi" for "lateral displays" is stiff. Use "paparan sisi" or "menunjuk-nunjuk dari sisi".
#18: "Ikan ini aktif pada waktu siang" is fine. However, "makanan ikan komersial" and "mengutip makanan" are slightly awkward. Use "makanan komersial" and "mengambil makanan".
